    The Hive¶

    An insectoid species inhabiting the northern wastelands of Lung Continent and the central region of Sister Continent. The Hive is not native to Ge'or — it was launched onto the planet by the allied species during The Last Great War as a weapons test, intended to evaluate its combat effectiveness against the Hybrian hivemind.

    The test was abandoned. The Hive remained.

    Biology¶

    The Hive operates as a caste-based species with specialized roles:

    • Drones — the most numerous. Zerg-like creatures that swarm in waves, overwhelming through numbers.
    • Warriors — larger, more intelligent. Similar to xenomorphs in form, with armored exoskeletons and devastating melee capability.
    • Queens — mountain-sized. Each queen controls a vast territory and spawns all other castes. The loss of a queen can cripple a Hive region for generations.
    • Spawning: Queens produce eggs continuously. A single queen can birth an army in months.

    The Eternal War¶

    The Hive has been locked in an eternal war with the Machines for thousands of years. Neither side can achieve permanent victory:

    • When the Hive advances, the machines develop new weapons and push back.
    • When the machines advance, the Hive adapts and evolves new castes.
    • The war is a stalemate — a perpetual arms race consuming both civilizations.

    The machines believe the Hive must be contained to prevent it from reaching the sea and spreading to other continents. The Hive has no such objective. It simply expands. It is not evil. It is a biological weapon that was never given a target — so it attacks everything.

    Origin¶

    Approximately 500,000 years ago, the allied species fighting the Hybrians launched a test species onto Ge'or to evaluate its combat capabilities. The Hive was that test. The allied forces monitored the planet briefly, concluded the insects were not effective enough, and abandoned the experiment.

    The machines, through their prophet The Elder, misinterpreted the radio signals announcing the test as a divine message from the sky.

    Connections¶

    • Enemy: Machines — eternal war
    • Origin: Weapons test by allied species during The Last Great War
    • Territory: Northern Lung Continent, central Sister Continent
    • Castes: Drones, Warriors, Queens

    The Sea Invasion¶

    The Hive is not content with Lung Continent and Sister Continent. Queens have been attempting to cross the sea to reach other landmasses. One such attempt was thwarted approximately 4,000 years ago by the Malgardian hero Zahor, who sacrificed himself to wound a Queen and delay the invasion. The Machines are unaware of these attempts. After 597 AGD, the Hive may try again.
